# ECG Record schema 1.1 — field reference

Emitted by this release: `1.1.0`. Readers accept schema major `1`. JSON Schema: `ecgfeat/schemas/ecg-record/1.1/schema.json` (`$id` `urn:ecg-record:1.1`).

Validation tiers come only from the shipped registry (`validation-evidence.json`); a field can claim more than `unvalidated` only by citing an evidence manifest (see `tools/check_validation_registry.py`).

## Debug-only and capped quantities

| Quantity | Tier | Ceiling | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/debug/st_morphology` | internal_debug | known_problem | The four-class ST morphology was never validated and is anti-correlated with ischemia; it must not be used as ischemia evidence. |
| `/debug/st_pattern_class` | internal_debug | unvalidated | No stable definition or validation. |
| `/debug/st_t_confusion` | internal_debug | unvalidated | No stable definition or validation. |
| `st_hybrid_*` | internal_debug | unvalidated | Experimental opt-in ST bypass (22 legacy keys); may appear only in debug output. |
| `twelve_sl_*` | internal_debug | unvalidated | Vendor-style compatibility block (16 legacy keys); not part of the core schema. |

## Absence states

Plain `null` (no stronger claim), `unmeasurable(reason)` and `not_applicable(reason)`. Dense fields encode reasons as a whole-field `{kind, reason}`, a per-field `default` state, and sparse `<beat_id>|<lead>` maps that override it.
